subject: Mutual action plan & security handoff — Praxis Financial evaluation
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@praxisfin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@praxisfin.com>, Praxis Financial Legal <legal@praxisfin.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP + security gates (SOC 2, CAIQ, DPA, retention)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency/cost profile. We want to put together a short mutual action plan so we can evaluate Redwood and get to a procurement decision. High level asks from our side: 

- SOC 2 Type II status and expected delivery date (we require the report before production go-live).
- Completed SIG/CAIQ or equivalent intake for our security team.
- Draft DPA with standard financial services carveouts and EU data residency options.
- Clarify data retention windows for user-generated content, logs, and backups (we need at least an option for 90-day content retention and 7-year audit logs for regulated records).

Target timeline: evaluation kickoff this week, acceptance decision by 2026-10-15, production pilot by 2026-11-01.

I've attached a short requirements snapshot (Praxis-MAP-reqs.pdf) that summarizes our gating items. Could you confirm Redwood's commitments and suggest owners/dates for each MAP line item?

Thanks,

Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Security | Praxis Financial
elena.ruiz@praxisfin.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: Praxis-MAP-reqs.pdf (PDF, 24KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@praxisfin.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@praxisfin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + security gates (SOC 2, CAIQ, DPA, retention)

Elena — really appreciate the clear asks and the timeline. Sharing a proposed MAP below and owners from our side. Happy to adjust during a short sync; I've copied Kimberly (security onboarding) and Marissa (legal/contract lead).

Proposed MAP (summary):
1) SOC 2 Type II: Redwood is currently in final audit cycle. We will provide an ETA for the finalized report by EOW (expected 2-3 weeks). Owner: Kimberly Park.
2) SIG/CAIQ: We can deliver a completed CAIQ export and our evidence bundle for the top 30 questions within 3 business days; full CAIQ spreadsheet and supporting artifacts within 7 days. Owner: Kimberly Park.
3) DPA: Marissa will circulate Redwood's standard DPA and a recommended redline addressing Praxis carveouts. We can accept EU data residency for scoped datasets via our Private deployment or region-specific hosting. Owner: Marissa Cole.
4) Data retention: Options: 30/90/365 days for content (default 90), audit logs retention up to 7 years with export on request; EU-only residency toggle for content. Kimberly to confirm technical feasibility and retention enforcement.
5) Acceptance decision & signatures: Draft MAP and contract redline to be completed by 2026-10-08, legal review and signature by 2026-10-15.

Next steps:
- I'll schedule a 30-minute MAP alignment call for tomorrow; Kimberly, could you prepare the CAIQ export and a short note on retention enforcement? Marissa, please prepare the DPA redline and mark any non-negotiables.
- I'll upload the joint MAP to a shared DocuSign/HubSpot link once we agree on the schedule.

Regards,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0124

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@praxisfin.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + security gates (SOC 2, CAIQ, DPA, retention)

Jordan / Marissa / Elena — quick clarifying note from security so we can scope the evidence and retention work properly.

A few questions for Praxis before we finalize the MAP:
- Data types: will you be sending full payment card data or only tokenized payment references? Any PI/PHI in the payloads?
- Volume profile: expected peak TPS and average daily tokens/user content size (this affects cache and retention policy enforcement).
- EU residency scope: is this for all user content or only EU-origin accounts?

What Redwood can commit to right now:
- CAIQ: attached is our working export (redwood-caiq-v2.xlsx). We'll flag the items that are evidence-in-progress.
- DPA: attached is a suggested redline (dpa-redline-suggested.docx) that adds a scoped EU residency annex and standard financial-services carveouts.
- Retention enforcement: we support tenant-level retention windows and can quarantine EU-resident content into region-specific storage; logs can be exported and archived for 7 years on request (we will need an SLA for export scheduling).

If Praxis confirms data categories and retention preference (we recommend 90-day content + 7-year audit logs as a baseline), we'll mark those MAP items as committed and lock dates.

-Kim

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Onboarding | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-caiq-v2.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB), dpa-redline-suggested.docx (DOCX, 32KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@praxisfin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial MAP + security gates (SOC 2, CAIQ, DPA, retention)

Forwarding Kimberly's notes and the CAIQ/DPA attachments — Elena, see Kim's questions inline (copied below). To keep the MAP tight, here's what Redwood is proposing as firm commitments once Praxis confirms data types: 

- CAIQ: deliver top-30 evidence bundle within 3 business days, full CAIQ + artifacts within 7 days.
- SOC 2: expected final report delivered by 2026-10-14 (audit wrapping this week). If anything slips we'll provide a signed attestation letter and offer a short pilot waiver tied to technical controls.
- DPA: Marissa will send a DocuSign-ready redline by EOD tomorrow; we can accept the EU residency annex for scoped datasets with the following mechanics: 1) tenant flag + region pin; 2) monthly export capability; 3) escalation path for data-subject requests.
- Retention: default proposal — content 90 days, backups 180 days, audit logs exportable up to 7 years.

Planned MAP milestones (dates):
- 2026-10-05: Redwood CAIQ top-30 delivered + DPA redline to Praxis legal.
- 2026-10-08: Contract redline complete and MAP doc uploaded to DocuSign.
- 2026-10-15: Signed DPA + MAP (go/no-go decision).

Elena — can you confirm: 1) that 90-day content retention + EU residency for EU-origin accounts is acceptable, and 2) whether Praxis will require any additional SOC 2 scope (e.g., PCI controls)? If so, we will raise with our audit team immediately.

Thanks,
Jordan

Date: 2026-10-06T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + security gates (SOC 2, CAIQ, DPA, retention)

Jordan / Kim / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround. Quick answers and confirmations from Praxis: 

- Data types: we will not be sending raw PANs; payment data will be tokenized. No PHI anticipated.
- Volume: expected peak is ~12 TPS, average daily traffic modest (will share numbers in the kickoff call).
- EU residency: confirmed for EU-origin accounts only (we need proof of region pin and monthly export).
- Retention: Praxis accepts the default proposal (content 90 days, backups 180 days, audit logs exportable for 7 years).
- SOC 2: Praxis legal will accept the SOC 2 Type II report when available; if audit finish slips, we'll accept a signed attestation + technical controls summary for pilot access.

Next steps for Redwood: please send the DocuSign MAP + DPA redline (Marissa) and upload the CAIQ top-30 evidence bundle. Praxis legal will review the DPA redline and aim to return comments by 2026-10-12.

Once the MAP doc is uploaded to DocuSign, I will route internally for final signature and confirm the go/no-go by 2026-10-15.

Best,

Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Security | Praxis Financial
elena.ruiz@praxisfin.com

Attachment: signed-map.pdf (PDF, stub - will be uploaded after signatures)
